description: This Perl module 'directories' defines simulated directory and file structures for testing FTP and directory listing functionalities. It exports functions to create directory content listings in Unix and DOS formats, as well as to retrieve file sizes and contents based on simulated data structures.

methods.name: ftp_createcontent
methods.description: Generates directory listing strings for Unix or DOS style directory listings based on internal simulated data structures.

methods.name: wildcard_filesize
methods.description: Returns the size of a specified file in the simulated directory structure, or -1 if not found or a directory.

methods.name: wildcard_getfile
methods.description: Retrieves the size and content of a specified file in the simulated directory structure, or indicates if it's a directory or not found.

methods.name: ftp_contentlist
methods.description: Public interface to get directory listing strings for a given simulated directory list name.
